notes.subject: ol taun pikinini bilong en
notes.rationale: בנות (ol pikinini meri) long pasin bilong ples — em i min 'ol taun liklik long klostu', tasol picsha bilong 'pikinini meri' i lus

notes.subject: עיה
notes.rationale: KJV ritim Gaza (גזה) tasol leta insait em i עיה — JPS 'Aiah', YLT 'Gaza'

notes.subject: geografi bilong graun
notes.rationale: lista bilong ol ples na ol相当于 border — kain measurement bilong graun

notes.subject: i stap
notes.rationale: copula — Hibru i no gat 'to be', Tok Pisin i nidim

translation: Ol samting ol i holim na ol ples ol i stap long en: Bet-El wantaim ol taun pikinini bilong en; na long sait bilong san i kamap, Naaran; na long sait bilong san i go daun, Gezer wantaim ol taun pikinini bilong en; na Sekem wantaim ol taun pikinini bilong en, inap long Aya wantaim ol taun pikinini bilong en.
